Inside Macintosh: Cyberdog Programmer's Kit / Part 3 - Cyberdog Reference
Chapter 7 - Classes and Methods / CyberSession

ICyberSession

Initializes this session object. 
void ICyberSession (in ODSession session);
session
The ODSession object associated with the current Mac OS process.
DISCUSSION
This method initializes a newly created session object. It detects, loads, and initializes the Cyberdog services available to the system. This method is called by Cyberdog during initialization.

Do not subclass this class.
